title: Sum of All Odd Length Subarrays
summary: Given an array of positive integers, calculate the total sum of all subarrays that have an odd length.
statement: Given an array of positive integers, calculate the total sum of all subarrays that have an odd length.
constraints: Sum every contiguous subarray whose length is odd.
hints: An element at index i belongs to (i+1)*(n-i) total subarrays.
Among these start/end choices, half rounded up have odd length.
Multiply the element by that odd-subarray count.
Summing contributions counts every element of every odd-length subarray exactly once.
editorial: Summing contributions counts every element of every odd-length subarray exactly once.

tests.explanation: Adding the five length-one, three length-three, and one length-five subarray sums gives fifty-eight.
Singletons total thirty-three and the full array adds thirty-three, giving sixty-six.
